pairs: complacuit sibi in illo anima mea:
with him my soul is well-pleased.
I have sent my Spirit upon him.
He will offer judgment to the nations.
and he will not show favoritism to anyone;
neither will his voice be heard abroad.
The bruised reed he will not break,
and the smoldering wick he will not extinguish.
He will lead forth judgment unto truth.
until he establishes judgment on earth.
And the islands will await his law.
and all that springs from it,
dans flatum populo qui est super eam,
who gives breath to the people in it,
and spirit to those walking on it.
Ego Dominus vocavi te in justitia,
I, the Lord, have called you in justice,
and I have taken your hand and preserved you.
et servavi te: et dedi te in fœdus populi,
And I have presented you as a covenant of the people,
as a light to the Gentiles,
so that you may open the eyes of the blind,
and lead out the prisoner from confinement
de domo carceris sedentes in tenebris.
and those sitting in darkness from the house of incarceration.
I will not give my glory to another,
nor my praise to graven things.
And I also announce what is new.
I will cause you to hear about them.
Sing to the Lord a new canticle,
sing his praise from the ends of the earth,
you who descend into the sea
Let the desert and its cities be lifted up.
They will cry out from the top of the mountains.
They will give glory to the Lord,
et laudem ejus in insulis nuntiabunt.
and they will announce his praise to the islands.
The Lord will go forth like a strong man;
He will shout and cry out.
He will prevail against his enemies.
I will speak like a woman giving birth.
I will desolate the mountains and the hills,
and I will wither all their grass.
And I will turn rivers into islands,
and I will dry up the pools of water.
Et ducam cæcos in viam quam nesciunt,
And I will lead the blind along a way which they do not know.
et in semitis quas ignoraverunt ambulare eos faciam;
And I will cause them to walk along paths with which they were unfamiliar.
ponam tenebras coram eis in lucem,
I will turn darkness into light before them,
These things I have done for them.
For I have not abandoned them.
confundantur confusione, qui confidunt in sculptili;
Let those who trust in graven idols be greatly confounded,
for they say to a molten thing,
nisi ad quem nuntios meos misi?
except the one to whom I have sent my messengers?
except the one who has been sold?
except the servant of the Lord?
Et Dominus voluit ut sanctificaret eum,
And the Lord was willing to sanctify him,
But this same people has robbed
All their youth are a snare,
et in domibus carcerum absconditi sunt;
and they have been hidden in houses of confinement.
there is no one who may rescue them.
there is no one who may say,
Quis est in vobis qui audiat hoc,
Who is there among you who will hear this,
and heed this in the future?
Who has handed over Jacob into plunder,
Is it not the Lord himself,
Et noluerunt in viis ejus ambulare,
And they were not willing to walk in his ways,
and they have not listened to his law.
Et effudit super eum indignationem furoris sui,
he poured out over him the indignation of his fury and a strong battle.
And he burned him all around,
and he did not realize it.
And he set him on fire,
and he did not understand it.
